_docs: GadgetGeeks Marketing Org — 24/7 Operating Schedule v1.0. Three shifts covering the full day. Modeled after enterprise operations centers (Google SRE, Amazon ops, Salesforce marketing ops). Every hour has an owner. No dead time.

morning_shift.name: Morning Shift (THE BUILD)
morning_shift.philosophy: This is when we CREATE. Content, designs, campaigns — the production engine runs here.

afternoon_shift.name: Afternoon Shift (THE PUSH)
afternoon_shift.philosophy: This is when we SELL and ENGAGE. Outbound calls, social engagement, email campaigns, conversion optimization.

night_shift.name: Night Shift (THE WATCH)
night_shift.philosophy: This is when we MONITOR and PREPARE. Overnight health checks, incident detection, next-day prep. Low-touch — automated monitoring with escalation.

daily_timeline._docs: Every scheduled event across the full 24-hour day. This is the master clock. All times UTC.

05:00.action: Collect overnight metrics, prepare standup data package, check all API health

05:30.action: Write handoff notes: overnight incidents, pending items, API status, what needs morning attention

06:00.action: Read all department states, night handoff, incident log. Compile standup: what each dept did yesterday, what's planned today, blockers. Send Telegram summary to boss.

06:23.action: Analyze keyword opportunities, write today's SEO recommendation

07:00.event: ECHO: X Intelligence + Daily Telegram Summary
07:00.action: Scan X/Twitter for market signals. Send daily summary to boss on Telegram.

07:41.action: Generate blog briefs from SEO opportunities + intel signals

08:19.action: Write 10 photorealistic AI image prompts for the day

08:49.action: Run 17-check quality audit on all prompts from LENS

08:53.action: Design and queue email campaign for approval

08:55.event: Gemini: Generate images from approved prompts
08:55.action: Generate images via Gemini Imagen 4 from FOCUS-approved prompts

09:25.action: Create finished social media designs from generated images

12:00.action: Pick next brief_ready topic, write 1,200-2,000 word blog. Reads daily-standup.json first to know what intel/SEO found.

09:45.action: Pick up CANVAS designs, write copy, post across platforms

13:00.action: Run 25-check scanner + deep qualitative review on draft blogs

14:30.action: Package qa_approved blogs for boss approval

15:00.action: Send Telegram report: what published today, pipeline status, upcoming drafts, any failures

10:47.action: Deep competitor analysis, trend identification, customer language mining

11:29.action: Conversion rate analysis, A/B test review, experiment proposals

14:15.action: Scan Shopify for abandoned carts, win-back candidates, review requests. Build call list for approval.

15:45.action: Make calls from approved call list via Vapi.ai

16:37.action: Monitor post performance, track engagement, flag standout content

18:51.action: Process approval queue, flag overdue items, move approved items to execution

20:00.action: Compile day results: what shipped, what's in progress, what failed. Write night handoff notes. Send Telegram summary to boss.

00:00.action: Check store uptime, API health, workflow status. Alert on failures.

03:00.action: Second health check. Verify no workflow failures overnight. Check Telegram for boss messages.

shift_handoff_protocol._docs: How shifts hand off to each other. The handoff file is the single source of truth.

in_progress: List of items still in progress
blockers: List of items blocked and why
incidents: Any new incidents from this shift

rules: NEVER start a shift without reading the handoff from the previous shift
The outgoing shift MUST write the handoff before clocking out
If the handoff file is missing or stale (>8 hours old), log an incident
Blockers in the handoff get auto-escalated per the escalation chain in org-chart.json

telegram_polling.purpose: Continuous command processing between scheduled events — this is the boss's real-time control channel
